jobs.title: TEMPORARY SCHOOLS PROGRAM COORDINATOR
jobs.description:
**TEMPORARY SCHOOLS PROGRAM COORDINATOR**

  

Position Type: Temporary, Full-Time (40 hours/week), Non-Exempt  
Employment Period: January–June 2027  
Reports To: Schools Program Manager  
Location: In-person at SFUSD school sites and LYRIC’s Purple House, San Francisco  
Hourly Rate: $30.58/hour (non-negotiable per LYRIC’s equity-based pay model)  
Union Status: Union position (OPEIU Local 29)

ABOUT THE POSITION

LYRIC seeks a thoughtful and experienced Temporary Schools Program Coordinator to deliver school-based support groups for SFUSD students, creating affirming spaces for LGBTQQ+ youth to strengthen positive identity development, self-esteem, personal growth, and peer connection. Serving 120 youth annually, the program offers weekly groups exploring healthy relationships, self-confidence, identity, and navigating school and community systems. Each cohort includes 3–10 students, averaging 5 participants, with sessions lasting up to 60 minutes, typically held in high school Wellness Centers or school-based health centers. The coordinator also connects students with LYRIC’s Purple House programs and supports programming there during spring break and summer break dates within the January–June employment period.

CORE COMPETENCIES

* Youth Development & Engagement: Build on young people’s strengths, center their voices and choices, and support their leadership, independence, and progress toward their goals.

* Equity & Inclusion: Create affirming environments for LGBTQQ+ youth across identities and backgrounds. Practice cultural humility, examine personal biases, and recognize how systemic barriers affect young people’s lives.

* Relationship Building & Collaboration: Build trust with youth, coworkers, and community partners. Coordinate services, share relevant information appropriately, and contribute to shared goals.

* Effective Communication: Listen actively, communicate clearly and respectfully, and address concerns directly and constructively. Adapt communication to different needs and situations.

* Emotional Awareness & Self-Management: Recognize how personal emotions and reactions affect others. Remain grounded during challenging interactions and respond with empathy, professionalism, and a trauma-informed approach.

* Critical Thinking & Sound Judgment: Assess situations, identify appropriate next steps, and recognize when to seek guidance. Respond to safety concerns within established protocols and the scope of the role.

* Professional Integrity & Accountability: Maintain appropriate boundaries and confidentiality, follow through on commitments, and take responsibility for actions. Communicate barriers early and follow organizational policies.

* Program Delivery & Organization: Prepare and deliver purposeful services and activities, manage time and resources responsibly, and complete accurate, timely documentation and follow-up.

* Learning & Adaptability: Seek and apply feedback, build relevant skills, and adjust to changing youth and program needs. Use reflection and experience to improve practice.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Youth Development & Group Facilitation

* Facilitate weekly support groups promoting positive identity development, self-esteem, healthy relationships, personal growth, and peer connection.
* Center youth voices and choices, creating opportunities for leadership and meaningful participation.
* Prepare and adapt age-appropriate curriculum informed by positive youth development, harm reduction, and youth sexual health education.
* Create inclusive, affirming environments that reflect students’ identities and address barriers to participation.
* Provide individual check-ins and basic resource support while maintaining boundaries and supporting youth independence.
* Respond to challenging group dynamics with empathy, self-awareness, and appropriate de-escalation; seek support when needed.

School-to-Community Connections

* Connect students with programs, services, and opportunities at LYRIC’s Purple House.
* Coordinate introductions, referrals, and follow-up with colleagues to help students access services and maintain engagement.
* Support Purple House programming during spring break and summer break dates within the employment period.

Program Planning & Partnerships

* Plan weekly sessions of up to 45 minutes for cohorts of 3–10 students.
* Prepare materials in advance, manage responsibilities across school sites, and use time and resources responsibly.
* Build collaborative relationships with school staff, counselors, Wellness Center staff, and community partners.
* Coordinate schedules, meeting spaces, and student referrals; communicate expectations and changes clearly.
* Participate in student support meetings when appropriate, sharing information within confidentiality requirements and the scope of the role.
* Use student feedback and participation data to improve programming and contribute to the program’s annual goal of serving 120 youth.

Documentation, Accountability & Safety

* Maintain accurate, timely records of participation, activities, referrals, and outcomes in LYRIC’s data systems.
* Contribute to program reports and funder documentation.
* Protect confidential information and follow procedures for storing and sharing records.
* Recognize safety concerns, follow reporting and response protocols, and consult the Schools Program Manager when guidance is needed.
* Follow through on commitments and communicate barriers early.

Teamwork & Professional Growth

* Participate in supervision, team meetings, trainings, and organization-wide events.
* Collaborate across departments and contribute to shared responsibilities.
* Seek and apply feedback, reflect on personal assumptions and reactions, and take responsibility for improvement.
* Adapt to changing school and program needs while communicating about priorities and capacity.
* Support an organized transition of program information and outstanding follow-up at the end of the assignment.

YOU BRING

jobs.title: Community Program Coordinator (Five88 & The Coronet)
jobs.description:
Project Access provides programs and services to over 27,000 children, families, and seniors living in affordable housing communities across the country. We strive to empower residents of affordable housing communities through our onsite services, aiming to create pathways for self-reliance and personal growth.  
  
Join the Project Access team and create impact in the lives of our residents. Hear from them and how their lives have changed: www.project-access.org/success-stories/

**The opportunity**

The Resident Services Coordinator designs and implements programs that enhance community life for residents of all ages. They serve as a vital link between residents and services, creating value through targeted initiatives that address community needs. This role requires an innovative, proactive individual who excels in an autonomous environment, driving positive long-term outcomes through an understanding of the communities in which they serve.

**What you'll do**

  

* Implement core programs and services, which include connecting, engaging, and empowering residents across four initiatives: Economic Stability, Education for Youth & Families, Health & Wellness, and Community Building.
* Conduct outreach and survey resident needs through community engagement aligned with our four pillars.
* Coordinate and oversee an after-school program and teen program encompassing homework assistance and educational enrichment activities.
* Coordinate and oversee diversified programs, activities and special events for seniors, including bingo, arts and crafts, monthly birthday parties, and lite exercise programs, as space permits.
* Independently plan, prepare, and facilitate resident-facing workshops and group sessions. When external partners are unavailable, deliver core topics directly to maintain consistency and resident engagement.
* Develop & maintain partnerships with local providers to deliver services and workshops.
* Plan & facilitate community-building events that foster safe and meaningful relationships between community members.
* Provide residents with information & referrals to access community resources and services, specifically connecting residents with nonprofit partners who deliver services within our four pillars framework.
* Support food distribution needs in the community, including maintaining food bank partnerships and distribution management.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with the property management team, scheduling regular communication sessions.
* Organize and conduct monthly outreach requirements including door-to-door outreach, digital/virtual outreach, and physical presence in high-traffic locations.
* Recruit, select, train, and oversee volunteers and interns who support programming at the Resource Center.
* Use personal automobile to acquire program supplies and donations and attend offsite meetings (mileage reimbursed at IRS rate).
* Publish monthly newsletters and calendar of events.
* Collect & submit program outcomes data with emphasis on social impact data collection to measure outcomes within our four pillars.
* Provide input and adhere to budgets for resident service programs, including authority to utilize funds for contractors when needed.

**What you'll bring**

* Bilingual English/Cantonese or English/Mandarin preferred
* Four years of experience in multi-family housing or related fields such as social services or community outreach; or a Bachelor's Degree in Social Work, Human Services, or related field.
* Experience in:
* + after-school programs or educational settings for youth
  + social services working with seniors.
  + serving diverse populations, demonstrating cultural competency and community awareness
* Proficient with MS Office (Excel, Word, Publisher, Outlook). Basic with Adobe Acrobat, Canva, Salesforce, Concur.
* Strong time management, administrative, and organizational skills.
* Self-starter, multi-tasker, and strong communicator
* The physical activity of this position includes minimal bending, walking, kneeling, reaching, and step climbing. Able to lift up to 30 pounds, which includes large boxes of food for a supplemental food distribution program.

**Credentials/Certifications**
==============================

* Valid Driver’s License, clean driving record, and current automobile insurance
* CPR & First Aid certified (or obtained within 90 days of hire)
* Successful completion of background check

**The details:**

* **This is a full-time (40 hrs/wk), non-exempt position and provides services at two sites.**
* **Schedule: Monday through Friday, 9am-5:30pm**
* + **Five88 Apartments (Family Resource Center):** Monday/Wednesday/Friday
  + **The Coronet (Senior Resource Center):** Tuesday/Thursday
* **Location**:
* + Five88 Apartments, 588 Mission Bay Blvd North, San Francisco, CA 94158; and
  + The Coronet Apartments, 3595 Geary Blvd, San Francisco, CA 94118
* **Wage:** $30/hr
* **Benefits offered**:
* + Health insurance, dental insurance, term life insurance, and an Employee Assistance Program (EAP). Additionally, the following voluntary benefits are available at 100% employee cost: vision insurance, voluntary life insurance, pet insurance, and supplemental benefits.
  + Safe Harbor 401(k) with 4% company match
  + Paid time off + 14 paid holidays

jobs.title: BP&S Compliance Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**The group you’ll be a part of**
---------------------------------

**The impact you’ll make**
--------------------------

We are seeking an experienced Audit & Compliance Coordinator to join our team. The ideal candidate has a deep understanding of ISO standards, regulations, and operations management, is detail-oriented and has excellent communication skills. This role is responsible for providing interpretation of and guidance on ISO 9001, 14001, 27001, 45001 standards, as well as applicable regulations and requirements, including training and preparing the organization for audit expectations. The Audit & Compliance Coordinator’s role is to contribute to our audit program to maintain high quality standards and improve audit performance and processes.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

* Assist with preparation and submittal of audit reports and performance data to management.
* Assist with the resolution process of any non-compliance issues/non-conformities discovered during audits.
* Assist with ensuring that all GWS procedures are well maintained, up to date, and acknowledged by appropriate stakeholders.
* Assist with the development and implementation of ISO procedures and documentation.
* Participate in risk assessments to identify potential areas of non-compliance.
* Complete regular inspections to ensure audit readiness.
* Actively participate in audits and inspections.
* Ensure department-wide understanding and adherence to regulatory, legal, and ISO standards.
* Train and support the organization on ISO requirements and changes.
* Monitor and report on the performance of proper use of IWMS by GWS, ensuring the system is being used and processes are followed.
* Acts as a subject matter expert for the team for audit related-requests and questions.
* Provide options on how best to facilitate improvements and new processes within GWS to ensure audit readiness and compliance.

**Who we’re looking for**
-------------------------

* Minimum of 8 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 6 years with a Master’s degree; or equivalent experience.
* 3+ years of experience in Facilities operations or a related field.
* 3+ years of experience in audit processes.
* Experience with training using adult learning principles, concepts, and development methods.
* Project management experience is a plus.
* ISO auditor certification is a plus.

**Preferred qualifications**
----------------------------

* Comfortable in a fast-paced, constantly changing environment.
* Comfortable working independently and as part of a team.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Outstanding customer service skills.
* Impeccable attention to detail.
* Extensive knowledge of ISO standards and regulations.
* Experience with audits and understanding of the audit process.
* Excellent training skills.
* Proficient in Excel and other Microsoft Office applications.
* Proven experience in operations.

**Our commitment**
------------------

We believe it is important for every person to feel valued, included, and empowered to achieve their full potential. By bringing unique individuals and viewpoints together, we achieve extraordinary results.

jobs.title: Community Health Advocate
jobs.description:
Asian Health Services, founded in 1974, provides medical, dental, and behavioral health services to more than 50,000 patients. Our approach to well-being focuses on “whole patient health” for all. We go beyond our clinic walls and invest in our community’s overall health. We know that income, housing, and environmental struggles lie at the heart of poor health. That’s why we also address food insecurity, youth leadership, and culturally competent care while working towards supporting safer streets and vibrant communities.

**Job Summary:**

As a key member of the Community Liaison Unit, the Community Health Advocate enhances access to and satisfaction with Asian Health Services by providing culturally and linguistically competent support to patients and community members. This role focuses on advocacy, community engagement, and outreach while representing the underserved Asian community's health rights and needs. The position involves planning and implementing advocacy activities, organizing health education events, and participating in public forums, policy discussions, and community partnerships.

### **Essential Job Functions**

* Conduct health education and outreach on topics like access to healthcare, mental health, and public policy.
* Attend and organize community events, workshops, and forums.
* Develop culturally appropriate health education materials and ensure their effective dissemination.
* Advocate for the rights and needs of the Asian community in public forums and policy discussions.
* Provide translation and interpretation services for healthcare interactions.
* Collect and analyze community data to support program development and evaluation.
* Serve as a back-up in patient services such as appointment scheduling, interpreting, and handling inquiries.
* Participate in agency-wide initiatives like fundraising and special events.

### **Minimum Qualifications**

* A Bachelor’s degree and two years of experience in a health-related field, or a high school diploma and four years of relevant experience.
* Knowledge of health and social services in Asian immigrant communities is preferred.
* Ability to work inclusively with diverse individuals across various socio-economic backgrounds.
* Strong problem-solving, leadership, and communication skills.
* Proficiency in English and one of the following languages: Cantonese, Mandarin, and/or Vietnamese

  

**Benefits That Support You**  
We're committed to supporting our team's well-being. Our comprehensive benefits package includes:

**Health & Wellness**

* 100% employer-paid medical, dental & vision coverage
* Acupuncture & chiropractic coverage

**Time Off**

* 12 vacation days
* 12 sick days
* 12 paid holidays + 3 floating holidays (additional flexible days you can use anytime)

**Financial & Retirement**

* 403(b) with 3% employer contribution + up to 2% match
* Flexible Spending Account (FSA) & Dependent Care Assistance

**Additional Support**

* Commuter benefits
* Long-Term Disability Insurance

**Please note:** We are not seeking support from staffing agencies at this time. Direct applicants only.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Medical Waste Operations Manager-Healthcare
jobs.description:
Clean Harbors is seeking a Hazardous Waste Operations Manager for our Medical Waste Division. In this position you will be responsible for overseeing all Company activities and managing the InSite staff on the customer site.

Clean Harbors is the leading provider of environmental, energy and industrial services throughout the United States, Canada, Mexico and Puerto Rico. Everywhere industry meets environment, Clean Harbors is on-site, providing premier environmental, energy and industrial services. We are solving tough problems through innovation and proven methodology – come be part of the solution with us.

**Why work for Clean Harbors?**

* Health and Safety is our #1 priority, and we live it 3-6-5!
* Focus on maintaining sustainability and cleaning the Earth.
* Competitive Recruiting pay range: $75K -$90K.
* Comprehensive health benefits coverage after 30 days of full-time employment including 401K with Company match.
* Own part of the company with our Employee Stock Purchase Plan.
* Opportunities for growth and development for all the stages of your career.
* Company paid training and tuition reimbursement.

**Responsibilities:**

* Ensure Health and Safety is the number one priority by complying with all safe work practices, policies, and processes and always acting in a safe manner.
* Manage and coordinate the efforts and Health and Safety oversite of the Clean Harbors onsite employees for customer's medical waste.
* Manage and track facility wide “cradle to grave” waste generation, storage, and disposal by providing waste tracking reports.
* Responsible for proper packaging of waste to maximize efficiency and maintain compliance.
* Schedule transportation and disposal of outgoing medical waste as needed.
* Maintain adequate levels of equipment for routine service needs and ongoing projects.
* Scope special projects and provide estimates.
* Assist customers with compiling data necessary for completing the Generator's Annual Report and other required reporting functions.
* Conduct facility wide compliance audits include inspections of staging, accumulating and storage areas to ensure proper housekeeping procedures and compliance.
* Maintain communication between customers, drivers, and central logistics team.
* Provides compliance information, maintenance, safety and permitting to Manager.
* Review logistics and work closely with customer service to understand shipping needs.
* Promotes safety by ensuring that personnel have the appropriate personal protective equipment, work plans, and training, etc.
* Understands expected job profitability by scheduling and managing resources efficiently.
* Follow all local, state (provincial) and federal compliance regulations and rules.
* Observe all company environmental health and safety operating guidelines.
* Performs other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree.
* Three- five years of hazardous waste experience preferably in healthcare.
* Alternative combinations of education and experience may be accepted in lieu of degree.
* Willing to get a Hep B Vaccination.

**Skills:**

* Leadership and management skills.
* Proficient in Windows based applications.
* Must be a team player.
* Strong customer service skills.
* Excellent interpersonal and organizational skills.
* Good organizational skills, decisiveness and initiative.
* Ability to work with little or no supervision.
* Ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously.
* Computer skills.
* Familiarity with EPA, DOT, NRC, and applicable state and local regulations.
* Working knowledge of Profit and Loss management.
* Working knowledge of Safety.

**Clean Harbors is an equal opportunity employer:**

Clean Harbors is committed to providing access, equal opportunity and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. To request reasonable accommodation, contact ect@cleanharbors.com or 1-844-922-5547.

The posted salary range reflects the minimum and maximum target for this role. Final compensation may vary based on factors such as location, experience, skills, and business needs. jobs.title: Finance and Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**ABOUT THE LYCÉE FRANÇAIS DE SAN FRANCISCO**

The Lycée Français de San Francisco (the Lycée) is a French immersion and International College Preparatory school with 820+ students across three Bay Area campuses. The Lycée strives to maintain an international community for teachers, parents, and students of diverse social and cultural backgrounds while providing a rich educational environment that emphasizes academic excellence and personal achievement.

Our program is based on the highly recognized French national curriculum and IB Curriculum and framework enriched by key American courses, allowing flexibility and academic transfer to leading schools and universities worldwide. The Lycée is a unique environment that promotes initiative, autonomy, cooperation, and individual responsibility.

**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Business Office Manager is a hands-on leadership role reporting directly to the Chief Financial & Operating Officer (CFOO). This individual owns the integrity of the school’s accounting operations, leading the Business Office team, driving an accurate and on-time full-cycle close, maintaining general ledger accuracy including restricted and unrestricted fund tracking, and producing reliable financial reporting. The Manager also oversees key operational functions across the school’s three campuses, including campus security, student transportation, and insurance/risk management. This is a working-manager role: the successful candidate leads by doing, builds strong processes and controls, and raises the quality bar of the Business Office through training, documentation, and accountability.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Accounting Operations & Full-Cycle Close**

* Own the full-cycle monthly, quarterly, and year-end close, delivering an accurate close on a fixed calendar with documented checklists and review controls.
* Oversee day-to-day Business Office operations, accounts receivable, accounts payable, and the general ledger in accordance with GAAP, FASB standards, and internal policies.
* Ensure expenses are coded to the correct general ledger accounts, departments, and funds; review and approve journal entries and account classifications.
* Maintain accurate tracking, release, and reporting of restricted versus unrestricted funds in accordance with donor intent and nonprofit fund accounting standards.
* Complete monthly bank reconciliations and ensure all balance sheet accounts are reconciled and reviewed on schedule.
* Ensure vendor payments are accurate and on time; establish AP review controls that prevent late or erroneous payments.
* Manage cash flow and ensure the Lycée’s cash position is optimized.
* Lead the automation of accounts payable and other manual processes; identify and implement efficiencies across financial operations.

**Team Leadership & Training**

* Manage, coach, and develop Business Office staff across all three campuses, setting clear expectations and providing performance feedback.
* Develop and document standard operating procedures for all accounting and finance functions.
* Train Business Office staff and school employees on accounting procedures, expense policies, and financial systems.

**Financial Reporting & Analysis**

* Produce accurate and timely monthly financial reports for the CFOO, Board of Trustees, and department managers, including statements of activities and financial position by fund.
* Assist the CFOO with the presentation of accounting and financial data to the Board.
* Reconcile project cost records and support budget variance analysis.
* Support preparation of annual operating and capital budgets across multiple departments and funding sources.

**Compliance, Filings & Audit**

* File and manage local property tax returns and other required filings related to school operations across all three campuses.
* Ensure all annual, quarterly, and periodic federal, state, and local filings are completed accurately and on time, in compliance with requirements applicable to a nonprofit educational institution.
* Lead audit preparation: year-end schedules, adjusting entries, and responses to auditor inquiries.
* Implement and enforce accounting policies and internal controls; work cross-departmentally to ensure financial matters comply with Lycée policies and applicable law.

**Operations: Security, Transportation & Risk**

* Oversee campus security operations across all three campuses, including vendor/personnel management, coverage schedules, incident records, and functioning security systems (cameras, access controls, alarms).
* Oversee the student transportation program with assistance of Transportation Specialist.
* Monitor and oversee insurance needs across all campuses; liaise with brokers on coverage sufficiency and escalate risk matters to the CFOO and Head of School as appropriate.
* Take on other operational duties as the school evolves, which may include construction and building projects and other cross-functional initiatives.

**QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE**

**Required**

* A minimum of 5 years of progressively responsible experience in finance and accounting, including ownership of a full-cycle close.
* Strong working knowledge of GAAP, FASB standards, and nonprofit fund accounting, including restricted/unrestricted fund tracking.
* Demonstrated experience supervising, training, and developing accounting staff.
* Track record of building processes and internal controls that improve accuracy and timeliness.
* Systems thinking: capacity to see and improve interconnections between accounting, operations, and compliance workflows.
* Regulatory agility: ability to track and respond to evolving local, state, and federal compliance requirements for educational nonprofits.

**Preferred**

* CPA or equivalent, or public accounting/audit background.
* Experience with Sage Intacct accounting software, Rippling, and AI tools.
* Experience with payroll registers and journals.

Pay: $115,000.00 - $125,000.00 per year

Work Location: I

jobs.description:
**Project Manager (Redwood City, CA)**

**JOB SUMMARY**  
The Project Manager (PM I) leads the planning, execution, monitoring, and delivery of business and technology initiatives that support organizational objectives. This role manages projects from initiation through implementation and closure, including a brief post-production stabilization period. Upon successful stabilization, ownership and ongoing support are transitioned to the designated business and technology support teams.

The Project Manager serves as the primary point of contact for project delivery and partners closely with business stakeholders, executive sponsors, IT teams, vendors, operational partners, and leadership to coordinate activities, manage risks, track and resolve issues, ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget, and drive successful outcomes that align with business goals.

While the primary focus of this role is project leadership and delivery, the Project Manager is also expected to perform Business Analyst functions when project needs require. This includes facilitating requirements gathering, documenting business and functional requirements, analyzing business processes, supporting solution design discussions, validating business needs, and assisting with testing and implementation activities. The Project Manager serves as a bridge between business and technical teams to help ensure solutions meet business objectives and operational needs.

In addition to managing assigned projects, the Project Manager plays an active role in project portfolio demand and intake management. This includes reviewing incoming project requests, ensuring requests are properly documented and filed within the project intake system, validating completeness of submitted information, coordinating follow-up activities as needed, and maintaining visibility into the project demand pipeline.

**Essential Functions**  
Essential Functions
  
Project Implementation & Delivery
  
Lead approved and prioritized cross-functional business and technology projects from initiation through closure.
  
Ensure Vendor Management due diligence requirements have been completed by the project owner prior to project implementation.  
  
Conduct stakeholder analysis and define project scope, objectives, deliverables, milestones, assumptions, constraints, and dependencies in partnership with project sponsors and stakeholders.  
  
Develop and maintain risk registers, including risk identification, assessment, mitigation strategies, and contingency plans, to minimize organizational exposure and project risk.  
  
Develop project work plans, schedules, key milestones, and target dates; drive project execution and adjust plans as necessary to ensure successful delivery of committed outcomes.  
  
Effectively apply PMO methodologies and enforce project governance, implementation, and delivery standards.  
  
Ensure project documentation is accurate, complete, current, and maintained within approved repositories.  
  
Business Analysis & Solution Validation  
  
Facilitate requirements gathering sessions with business stakeholders, subject matter experts, vendors, and technical teams.  
  
Document and maintain business requirements, functional requirements, business rules, process flows, use cases, and acceptance criteria.  
  
Analyze current-state and future-state business processes and identify opportunities for operational improvement and process optimization.  
  
Validate proposed solutions with stakeholders and confirm business needs, requirements, and project objectives have been addressed.  
  
Testing, Implementation & Operational Readiness  
  
Coordinate testing activities, user acceptance testing, implementation planning, deployment readiness, and go-live activities.  
  
Partner with impacted business units to ensure operational procedures, departmental workflows, job aids, training materials, and supporting documentation are developed or updated to reflect new or modified processes, systems, controls, regulatory requirements, and operational changes introduced by the project.  
  
Ensure all tracked issues, defects, risks, and action items are resolved, mitigated, formally accepted, or appropriately documented prior to deployment.  
  
Confirm stakeholder expectations have been met and obtain final approval and signoff from impacted business owners and the appropriate Vice President(s) prior to production deployment.  
  
Facilitate a successful transition to operational ownership and support following implementation and stabilization.  
  
Portfolio Intake & Demand Management  
  
Support administration and management of the project portfolio demand and intake pipeline.  
  
Ensure project requests are appropriately documented, categorized, tracked, and routed through the intake process.  
  
Maintain accurate intake and portfolio records to support project prioritization, capacity planning, and portfolio reporting.  
  
Provide visibility into project demand, resource needs, and portfolio pipeline status to leadership.  
  
**Knowledge & Business Acumen**

**Financial & Operational Management**  

* Understand project budgeting, financial planning, and cost management principles.
* Understand cost-benefit analysis and business case development.
* Understand vendor contracts, project-related legal documents, and procurement processes.

**Technical Knowledge**  

* Understand software development lifecycle (SDLC) methodologies and information technology concepts.
* Understand web-based, cloud, internet, and client-server architectures.
* Awareness of emerging technologies and industry trends.
* Proficiency with project management and business analysis tools, including Microsoft Project, OneNote, Visio, Jira, Microsoft Office Suite, MS Teams, and other tools.

  
**Analytical & Communication Skills**

* Ability to synthesize complex information from multiple stakeholders, business units, vendors, and technical team

jobs.description:
**About DCL Logistics**

For over 40 years, DCL Logistics has powered the brands that shape how the world shops. We are a modern 3PL and a technology company at heart, trusted by high-growth, innovative names in consumer electronics, health and beauty, wellness, and connected devices. Our proprietary platforms (eFactory, SelectShip, and ReturnTrak) give our clients full command of their supply chain, and our ISO 9001:2015 certified facilities deliver the precision and quality their customers expect. Headquartered in Silicon Valley with a national network reaching 96% of the U.S. population on two-day ground, we help ambitious brands scale without limits.

**Why DCL**

We are more than a fulfillment company. We are a team of people who make it happen. Our culture is built on four core values that show up in everything we do: Make It Happen, Be Resourceful, Deliver Operational Excellence, and We Care. Here, your work is visible, your ideas matter, and your impact is real from day one. We move fast, we hold ourselves to the highest standard, and we take care of our people. When you join DCL, you don't just join an organization. You join a family.

**Location Requirements:**

This is a hybrid position. Candidates must currently reside within a reasonable commuting distance of one of the following locations: Louisville, KY; York, PA; the San Francisco Bay Area, CA; Perris, CA; Ontario, CA; or the greater Southern California area.

**About the Role**

The Project Manager (PM) will lead internal initiatives to improve efficiency, scalability, and performance across our fulfillment network. This role is focused on both **operational execution** and **IT project delivery**—driving cross-functional initiatives, implementing systems, and standardizing processes that support our warehouse operations and technology platforms. The Project Manager will partner with stakeholders across operations, IT, engineering, customer service and leadership to ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and with measurable business impact.

This role reports directly to the Company President.

**Responsibilities**

* Plan and manage cross-functional projects end-to-end: scope, timeline, budget, resources, risks, and dependencies.
* Serve as the central point of coordination between IT, Operations, Accounting, and other functional teams, translating each group's priorities and constraints into a shared project plan.
* Run regular status meetings, steering committee updates, and stakeholder check-ins; maintain clear, consistent project documentation (charters, RAID logs, status reports).
* Identify and resolve cross-departmental bottlenecks, conflicting priorities, and resource contention before they become blockers.
* Establish and improve lightweight project management standards, templates, and governance so future cross-functional work doesn't have to start from scratch.
* Track project health (scope, schedule, budget, risk) and escalate proactively when a project is at risk.
* Partner with functional managers to ensure resources are allocated appropriately without disrupting day-to-day departmental operations.
* Support post-project reviews and capture lessons learned to continuously improve delivery.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, Supply Chain, Information Systems, Industrial Engineering, or related field.
* **PMP Certified with 3–6 years o**f project management experience in logistics, fulfillment, supply chain, or IT project delivery.
* Strong understanding of fulfillment and warehouse operations, as well as related technology systems.
* Experience leading IT projects involving WMS, OMS, ERP, or ecommerce integrations.
* Excellent organizational and communication skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Proficiency in project management tools (Asana, Smartsheet, Jira, or equivalent).
* PMP, Lean Six Sigma, or ITIL certification a plus.

----------------------

CTI has been a leading audiovisual provider since we began in 1988, and from the beginning our mission has been simple: to provide a fantastic customer experience.  
  
At CTI, our biggest asset is our people, and we know that sometimes the most awesome employees don’t fit the typical mold. If you are hardworking, friendly, and know the importance of fantastic customer service, you could be a good fit at CTI. We have developed a collaborative and lively working environment, where the best and the brightest show up to work each day ready to have fun and employ their passion for and knowledge of technology in everything they do. This creative atmosphere helps us apply and share our skills with our clients, who seek quality, high-end AV and Conference Solutions.

**What are we looking for?**

Are you a passionate AV enthusiast with a knack for project management? We're looking for an experienced AV Project Manager who embodies our mission: “to provide a fantastic customer experience.” We need a dynamic, highly organized self-starter who isn't afraid to roll up their sleeves and get the job done on time. You'll handle all aspects of AV integration projects, excel at delegating responsibilities, and possess top-notch communication skills.

**What’s in it for you?**

At CTI, we know our company’s success is directly correlated to the success of our employees. So, it’s fitting that we thrive on and encourage employee growth, both professionally and personally. Our competitive compensation package includes:

A culture where “fun is mandatory”, teams value your ideas, we celebrate wins (big and small), and you have support. As well as opportunities for growth and learning.

* Employer-matched medical, prescription, and dental insurance (available after 60 days of employment)

jobs.description:
**About Stratus**

Stratus® is an integrated, multi-disciplinary engineering, architecture, interior design, and consulting firm. Consistently ranking among the Top 500 Design Firms in Engineering News-Record, the firm offers a deep bench of industry experts through a highly collaborative approach, delivering innovative solutions across the full project lifecycle. Operating coast to coast, Stratus® serves clients nationwide while maintaining a strategic commitment to supporting high-growth economies and building vibrant communities that foster the professional growth of its team. Serving public- and private-sector clients, the firm is dedicated to delivering the highest-quality service wherever projects take shape. Across the Civic, Commercial, Industrial, Transportation, Education, Water Resources, and Government sectors, we bring precision, insight, and purpose to every project, from targeted renovations to large-scale infrastructure. Stratus® designs spaces, systems, and solutions that perform, endure, and make an impact, delivering on our promise of Better Plans. Better Places.

  

**The Role**

Stratus® has recently partnered with E.A. Bonelli, and we're hiring a Design Technician for our Structural engineering group. This role is responsible for creating, managing, and coordinating complex structural design models and construction documentation for building and infrastructure projects. This role leads our structural BIM/CAD efforts, ensures alignment with engineering calculations and design intent, and supports multi-disciplinary coordination. The position requires independent execution of advanced modeling tasks, close collaboration with structural engineers, and mentorship of junior designers to deliver high-quality, code-compliant structural documents.

  

**Responsibilities:**

* Develop detailed structural 2D and 3D CAD/BIM models (g.Framing plans, foundation plans, sections, details, connection layouts) aligned with engineering calculations and specifications.
* Lead multi-disciplinary coordination, ensuring structural systems integrate with architectural, MEP and civil models without clashes.
* Perform and oversee control reviews of structural drawings and models, verifying accuracy, constructability, and compliance with applicable building codes and project standards.
* Collaborate closely with structural engineers to translate design criteria, load paths, and calculations into accurate constructible documents.
* Mentor junior designers on structural drafting standards, detailing best practices, and BIM/CAD workflows.
* Generate and manage structural construction documents, including general notes, schedules (steel, rebar, concrete), and detailed sections.

Your ability to manage these expectations and be responsive when critical issues arise is key to your success in this role and our collective success as a team.

  

**A Drug Free Workplace:** Clark promotes a drug free workplace. A pre-employment drug “fitness for duty” screening is required, and the company conducts random quarterly drug “fitness for duty” tests.

Overview::

**Sr Project Manager & experience Project Architect - Community, Workplace & Government (CWG) markets**

Location: Northern California

Join HGA's CWG team as an **Architectural Project Manager and experienced Project Architect** in one of our Northern California offices. We are seeking a highly motivated architectural professional who brings both strong project leadership and technical expertise to successfully deliver projects from concept through completion.

As a seasoned practitioner, you will have a minimum of eight (8) years of architectural experience, including project management responsibilities and independent leadership of multiple small to midsize projects. This role is responsible for overseeing all aspects of project delivery, including planning, budgeting, scheduling, team coordination, consultant management, and client communication, while ensuring design excellence and successful project outcomes.

**What we're looking for:**

The ideal candidate is an experienced architect who can confidently lead projects, clients, and teams. While new construction experience is preferred, candidates with significant renovation and modernization project experience will also be considered. Beyond technical capabilities, we are seeking a leader who:

  

* Demonstrates strong design sensibility and sound architectural judgment.
* Builds trusted relationships with clients, consultants, and contractors.
* Maintains exceptional organization and project management skills.
* Effectively delegates work, mentors team members, and leverages resources efficiently.
* Thrives in a dynamic environment where project priorities and workloads may shift quickly.
* Makes strategic decisions that support project success, team health, and long-term client relationships rather than simply managing to project metrics.

**In this role you will:**

**Project Leadership**

  

* Independently manage multiple projects from concept through completion.
* Develop and oversee project work plans, budgets, schedules, and staffing.
* Ensure design quality, technical accuracy, and code compliance throughout all phases.

**Client Engagement**

  

* Serve as the primary client liaison, building trust and ensuring satisfaction.
* Lead presentations, facilitate approvals, and translate client goals into actionable strategies.

**Team Coordination**

  

* Direct and mentor project teams, fostering collaboration and accountability.
* Coordinate consultants and stakeholders to ensure integrated project delivery.

**Documentation & Administration**

  

* Manage contracts, RFIs, submittals, meeting minutes, and change orders.
* Maintain organized and accurate project documentation in line with firm standards.

**What you will need to have:**

  

* Professional degree in Architecture or related field from an accredited institution.
* Minimum of 8 years of experience, with at least 3 years in a project management role.
* Architectural licensure preferred or in progress.
* Proficiency in Revit, AutoCAD, Adobe Creative Suite, and project management tools.
* Strong leadership, communication, and organizational skills.
* Deep understanding of building codes, construction methods, and project delivery.

**Salary Information:**

The pay range listed aligns to the geography of the office for which this position is posted. Actual compensation will be based upon work experience, education, licensure requirements and/or skill level and will be finalized at the time of offer. Individuals in this role working more than 24 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in HGA’s robust benefit programs which include an annual bonus and success sharing bonus program, 401(k) guaranteed contribution, paid parental leave, medical, dental and life insurance plans as well as PTO and short- and long-term disability programs. Salary Range: $110,000 - $132,000 **depending on location, qualifications and experience**.

**Additional Information:**

At HGA, you’ll do the best work of your career. We design with impact by diving deep into the people and passions that shape every place. Empathy fuels us, curiosity drives us, and meaningful work leads to innovation. We celebrate individuality, embrace flexibility, and thrive together in the office three days a week.

Join our nationally recognized, award-winning team of architects, engineers, and interior designers — help us shape what’s next.

Learn more about us here.

**Application Requirements & Instructions**  
Please submit resume for consideration.

**Who We Are**

At Hamilton Families, our mission is to end family homelessness in the San Francisco Bay Area. Since 1985, we have been meeting the most urgent needs of unhoused families in our community. Our programs specialize in preventing family homelessness when possible, providing shelter and transitional housing to families in times of need, supporting the wellbeing and academic achievement of children who experience homelessness, and quickly returning families to safe and stable housing throughout the Greater Bay Area. At Hamilton Families, we believe the San Francisco Bay Area is at its best when people from all backgrounds can start a life here, raise a family here, and thrive here. We envision a Bay Area where housing is accessible and affordable, where homelessness is rare, brief, and nonrecurring, and where all people and families have a safe and stable place to live. We foster an inclusive environment where diverse perspectives are valued and contribute to our collective success. Our commitment to inclusivity ensures every team member feels respected, supported, and empowered to thrive.

**What You’ll Do**

We’re excited to be adding a **Case Manager, Stability,** toour growing team! This is an engaging and rewarding opportunity that plays an integral role within the organization. We are looking for someone who is passionate about working with our participants and contributing to the fight against homelessness. This position requires the individual to be bilingual in Spanish in order to better serve our community. The **Case Manager, Stability**, will report directly to the Shelter Coordinator and be part of the Housing Solutions team. This position provides case management to families in the rental subsidy program using various service models. This involves documenting services in real-time, maintaining electronic case records, and collecting monthly compliance reports.

* Provide home-based support to around 20 families, including goal setting, housing advocacy, and connecting them to resources for budgeting, employment, legal support, and more
* Assess participants’ needs and challenges, such as employment status or mental health, and connect them to appropriate resources
* Assist families in setting and reaching housing goals, manage necessary documentation, and address related concerns
* Check in with participants who have completed the program to ensure continued progress
* Foster self-sufficiency and maintain professional boundaries using various service models
* Collaborate with internal teams, and external partners to address housing issues and support participants
* Maintain accurate records and adhere to confidentiality documentation standards
* Address resource needs in specific areas and help organize community events such as Holiday celebrations and Back-to-School activities
* Partner on departmental projects as needed
* Advocate for our services and represent Hamilton Families at community and collaborative meetings

**What Makes You Successful in This Role**

* Ability to work and collaborate with a diverse group of people on projects and making decisions for the benefit of our participants
* Familiarity with case management databases or customer service platforms
* Highly organized, self-motivated, and capable of working independently to meet goals
* Demonstrated ability to exercise appropriate judgement and uphold policies and procedures
* Skilled in documentation, reporting, and maintaining confidentiality

**What You Bring**

* 1+ years of experience in social work, psychology, human services setting or related field
* A background in working with nonprofit organizations, social services organizations, or community-based programs
* Familiarity with Bay Area resources for low-income families
* Bilingual abilities, especially in Spanish
* Highly proficient in Microsoft Office Suite, Salesforce, and other software

We envision a Bay Area where housing is accessible and affordable, where homelessness is rare, brief, and nonrecurring, and where all people and families have a safe and stable place to live. We foster an inclusive environment where diverse perspectives are valued and contribute to our collective success. Our commitment to inclusivity ensures every team member feels respected, supported, and empowered to thrive.

**What You’ll Do**

We’re excited to be adding a **Case Manager** toour team! This is an engaging and rewarding opportunity that plays an integral role within the organization. We are looking for someone who is passionate about working with our participants and contributing to the fight against homelessness. The **Case Manager** will report directly to the Family Services Manager and be part of the Shelter Program team. This position provides case management to families in the shelter program using various service models. This involves documenting services in real-time, maintaining electronic case records, and collecting monthly compliance reports.

* Actively participate in team meetings, training sessions, and community events to strengthen our mission
* Ensure compliance with all regulatory requirements and organizational policies, and attend hearings as needed
* Encourage participant involvement in decision-making and program activities, fostering a sense of ownership
* Take on additional responsibilities as requested to support our mission

**What Makes You Successful in This Role**

* Ability to work and collaborate with a diverse group of people on projects and making decisions for the benefit of our participants
* Familiarity with case management databases or customer service platforms
* Highly organized, self-motivated, and capable of working independently to meet goals
* Demonstrated ability to exercise appropriate judgement and uphold policies and procedures
* Skilled in documentation, reporting, and maintaining confidentiality

**What You Bring**

* A background in working with nonprofit organizations, social services organizations, or community-based programs
* Familiarity with Bay Area resources for low-income families
* Bilingual abilities, especially in Spanish
* Highly proficient in Microsoft Office Suite, Salesforce, and other software
* Ability to travel locally and long distance to meet with vendors and participants

**Why Choose Us**

* Enjoy excellent medical, dental, and vision coverage

jobs.title: RCM Operations Specialist, Infusion (AI Platform)
jobs.description:
**About Trellis**  
Trellis builds AI that handles intake, benefits, prior authorization and reimbursement for infusion and specialty pharmacy providers, so patients start therapy faster and providers get paid for it.

**The role**  
You will be our expert on infusion prior authorization and reimbursement. Our system reads referrals, clinical notes and payer policies, then prepares the work that intake and reimbursement teams do by hand today. Your job is to make sure that work is right. You will review real cases across our customers, catch what the system gets wrong and explain why. Then you turn that judgment into rules and test cases our engineers build on. You will work directly with the product and engineering team.

**What you will do**

* Review prior authorization and reimbursement cases for infusion customers, covering benefits, coverage, PA requirements, medical necessity, billing codes and units
* Check each decision against payer policies, Medicare LCDs and NCDs, payer portals and the patient's clinical documentation
* Build answer keys that record the correct outcome for real cases, with the reasoning and source behind each call
* Find patterns in errors and write them up clearly for product and engineering, with examples
* Keep a working library of payer rules, drug coverage criteria and billing conventions up to date
* Learn how customer intake and reimbursement staff handle edge cases, and bring those conventions into the product
* Review early output during customer onboarding and flag risk before it reaches a claim

**What you bring**

* 3+ years in infusion or specialty pharmacy revenue cycle, such as prior authorization, benefits verification, billing, denials or appeals
* Working knowledge of medical versus pharmacy benefit, buy and bill, HCPCS J codes, administration CPT codes, NDC to billing unit conversion and modifiers
* Comfort reading LCDs, NCDs and commercial medical policies and applying them to a specific patient
* Experience with payer portals and PA tools such as Availity or CoverMyMeds, and pharmacy or infusion systems such as CPR+ or WellSky
* Careful judgment. You know the difference between what the chart says and what someone assumed
* Clear writing. You can explain a denial risk in two sentences to someone who has never billed a claim

**Nice to have**

* A CPC, CPB, CRCS or similar certification, or a pharmacy technician or nursing background
* Experience at a home infusion provider, ambulatory infusion center or specialty pharmacy
* Experience with biologics, IVIG and other high cost therapies across Medicare, Medicaid and commercial plans
* Curiosity about how AI can change healthcare operations. No coding required

**About the interview**
-----------------------

* **Intro call with Ahmed (30 min).** Your background, the kind of reimbursement work you have done, and what you want next.
* **Case review exercise (60 to 90 min).** We share two or three anonymized infusion referrals with the relevant payer policy. You decide whether a PA is needed, whether the case meets coverage criteria, and how it should be billed. Then we go through your reasoning together. We care more about how you think and where you look than about a perfect answer.
* **Team conversations (45 min).** Meet the people on product and engineering you will work with every day, and ask anything about how we build.
* **References and offer.** We move quickly and will tell you where you stand after each step.

Compensation Range: $70K - $120K

jobs.title: Business Operations Lead
jobs.description:
**The Opportunity**
-------------------

Seneca is seeking a **Business Operations Lead** to run strategic finance, accounting, contracts, insurance, compliance, purchasing, payroll and benefits, and the office. Right now those things are spread across an outside accounting firm, a payroll vendor, outside counsel, a fractional Head of Ops and the CEO. As we continue to scale, we are seeking someone who can up-level this organization both in terms of our daily operations and in key moments like M+A, equity and debt financings, key partnerships etc.

This role reports to the CEO with tight partnership. There will be opportunity to hire and/or bring in additional outside resources over the next twelve months.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

**Finance & Accounting**

* You run the finance function. Both FP&A and accounting.
* Partner with teams to ensure they pick the right strategies for both cost and revenue optimization as Seneca scales.
* Own the monthly close with our outside accounting firm.
* Get the accounting right for a hardware company moving into production: inventory, BOMs, capitalized R&D, fixed assets, and revenue recognition on multi-year contracts with agencies and utilities.
* Handle invoicing and collections, including milestone billing on government and utility contracts.
* Figure out the right policies for expense management and suggest our monthly budget – keeping us tracking to it.
* Keep the budget and board package current.

**Contracts, Compliance & Risk**

* Own contracts. Work with outside counsel on customer agreements, supplier terms, NDAs, and government contracting paperwork. Know what we have signed and what it commits us to.
* Own insurance, including aviation and product liability. For a drone company this is real work.
* Keep the compliance calendar: corporate filings, state registrations, export controls, and the requirements that come with selling to public agencies.

**Purchasing & Vendors**

* Run purchasing so engineers can get what they need fast and we still know where the money went: approvals, corporate cards, expense policy, vendor setup.
* Negotiate large vendor and supplier agreements.
* Partner with outside lawyers on where to draw the lines on NDAs, partnership agreements, and any other day to day legal questions.

**People Operations**

* Oversee payroll, benefits, and the HRIS through our vendors.
* Help us continue to drive exceptional recruitment.
* Own compensation and equity: bands, offers, grants, refreshes, and the promotion process, with the CEO.
* Make sure the basics are covered: I-9s, multi-state registrations, handbook, required trainings. Bring in outside HR counsel when a situation calls for it.
* Be someone employees can come to in confidence when something is wrong.

**Systems & the Office**

* Own the finance and ops systems (Ramp, Rippling, Carta, QuickBooks) and decide when to replace one.
* Run the Sausalito office: lease, facilities, IT and security basics, equipment. There are others in the loop here, but you have the opportunity to formalize facilities.

**What You Bring**
------------------

This is a high visibility / high upside role for a candidate who wants to be an early strategic partner to an experienced CEO in a high impact, high growth startup. You’ll often partner with the CEO, so a history of excellence is valued.

* Experience in strategic finance or private equity and/or investment banking
* You have run finance and operations at a venture-backed startup, ideally one that builds hardware, through a period of real growth.
* You understand accounting well enough to manage an outside firm and catch their mistakes: GAAP, revenue recognition, inventory, capitalized R&D.
* You are a generalist and you like operating. You fix things rather than write about them.
* You love to design scalable operational processes, including automating manual workflows, identifying future bottlenecks, and evaluating tools, partners, and vendors for long-term scalability
* You handle confidential information with care.
* You write and speak plainly, and you can explain business concepts to anyone.
* You want to work in person in Sausalito.

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* **Competitive Salary** — Reflective of your skills and experience
* **Equity Compensation** — Be an owner in the company's future
* **Comprehensive Health Coverage** — Medical, dental, and vision plans
* **Health Savings Account (HSA)** — Optional pre-tax savings for medical expenses
* **Unlimited PTO** — Flexible time off to recharge, plus paid company holidays

**About Us**  
Seneca is building cutting-edge drone and sensor technology for wildfire suppression, aiming to eliminate wildfire risk across 500 million acres of high-risk U.S. + allied territory. Backed by top-tier investors, including Convective Capital, Caffeinated Capital, First Round Capital, Slow Ventures, Nextview Ventures, Transition Capital, Bullpen Capital, Stepstone Group, Roar Capital, Offline Ventures, and leaders from Palantir, Google, Meta, and many others. Founded by Stu Landesberg (former Founder & CEO of Grove Collaborative — IPO in 2022 at $1.7B) and fire industry experts, Seneca is a mission-driven company dedicated to climate resilience and fire prevention.

**Don’t meet every single requirement?** If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification, we encourage you to apply — you may still be the right fit for our team.

Compensation Range: $125K - $200K

jobs.title: Sr. Business Analyst - Corporate Strategy

We partner with OEMs and suppliers across the mobility space, as well as clients in non-mobility industries, to deliver innovative solutions and accelerate product development.

On a mission to democratize AI, Zilliz is committed to simplifying data management for AI applications and making vector databases accessible to every organization.

**About the Role**

We're looking for an Events & Operations Specialist to help plan and execute Zilliz's marketing and community events, while also supporting selected internal operations.

You'll work closely with our Marketing, Sales, and Developer Relations teams to coordinate everything from developer meetups and customer events to industry conferences and trade shows. This is a hands-on role that involves working with both internal teams and external partners to keep projects organized and events running smoothly.

We're looking for someone who's organized, dependable, and comfortable taking initiative. You should enjoy working with different people, solving problems as they come up, and finding ways to improve how things get done. Events will be your primary focus, with a smaller portion of the role dedicated to internal operational and administrative support.

### **What You'll Do**

**Events & Marketing Support**

* Coordinate the planning and execution of developer meetups, community gatherings, sales events, conferences, and trade shows, primarily across North America and Europe.
* Manage event logistics, including registration, attendee communications, venue arrangements, vendors, materials, and on-site coordination.
* Work with Marketing, Sales, and DevRel teams to understand event objectives, coordinate resources, and ensure activities are delivered on schedule.
* Maintain event timelines, budgets, and task lists, follow up with stakeholders, and address issues that could affect execution.
* Coordinate with external vendors, venues, speakers, and partners throughout the event planning process.
* Contribute ideas to improve event formats, attendee engagement, and the overall event experience.
* Support post-event activities, including attendee follow-ups, lead coordination, feedback collection, and basic performance reporting.

**Internal Operations & Administrative Support**

* Assist with day-to-day operational and administrative tasks.
* Help coordinate internal meetings, team activities, and other operational needs as they arise.
* Support improvements to internal processes and team coordination where needed.

### **What We're Looking For**

* At least 2 years of relevant professional experience in event marketing, event coordination, operations, or a related field.
* Hands-on experience organizing events or managing projects involving multiple stakeholders, timelines, and deliverables.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage competing priorities and follow through on commitments.
* A proactive approach to work, with the ability to identify problems, take initiative, and move projects forward with limited supervision.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with experience coordinating across internal teams and working with external vendors or partners.
* Comfortable working in a startup environment where priorities can change and processes may not always be clearly defined.
* A practical, resourceful approach to problem-solving, along with the willingness to contribute new ideas and take on different types of work.
* Willingness to travel domestically and occasionally internationally to support events.

### **Nice to Have**

* Experience with developer meetups, technical community events, or B2B technology conferences.
* Familiarity with developer communities, open-source technologies, AI, or data infrastructure.
* Experience working in a startup or fast-growing technology company.

jobs.title: Global Network BMCC Committee Program Manager

The Global Network BMCC Committee Program Manager provides hands-on project management, coordination and operational support for the BMCC committee and related network priorities. Working with leaders and colleagues across US and Group member firms, this role helps translate committee direction into organized workplans, well-prepared meetings, clear action items and timely follow-through. The ideal candidate is an early-to-mid-career professional who communicates clearly, manages details well and is comfortable coordinating multiple workstreams in a collaborative global environment.

**What You Will Do:**

* Maintain annual committee calendars, forward agendas and workplans; coordinate recurring meetings and working sessions; and help ensure priorities, milestones and dependencies are visible and actively managed.
* Build agendas, briefing materials, presentations and meeting decks; coordinate inputs, version control and final review; document decisions and action items; and follow up with owners to support timely completion.
* Develop and maintain project plans, timelines, status reports, decision logs, action trackers and shared files for committee-sponsored initiatives; identify risks, gaps and dependencies; and escalate issues when needed.
* Serve as a central point of coordination across committee members, workstream leads and BMCC colleagues across the US and Group; schedule working sessions, gather inputs and keep stakeholders informed of progress, decisions and upcoming deadlines.
* Assist with building, organizing and maintaining a central library of tender materials, credentials, case studies and reusable content; help ensure materials are current, clearly labelled and easy to find.
* Track agreed priorities, milestones and KPIs; maintain basic reports or dashboards; and compile recurring updates for committee and network leadership.
* Coordinate production of committee and network updates from planning through distribution, including gathering inputs, drafting and editing copy, managing reviews and maintaining the production schedule.
* Gather information from stakeholders and write concise stories that showcase significant client wins, cross-border collaboration and network capabilities in support of BMCC and Go-To-Market (GTM) priorities.

* Provide additional coordination, communications and production assistance for BMCC, GTM and other network priorities as needs evolve.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in business, project management, communications, marketing or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Three to four years of experience in a program coordination, project management or committee support role, preferably within a global, business development, GTM or professional services environment.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Strong project management and organizational skills, including the ability to manage workplans, deadlines, dependencies, files, reviews and multiple assignments.

* Experience in leveraging AI and other productivity tools to improve efficiency, coordination and outcomes.
* Comfort working with senior leaders and colleagues across functions, geographies and time zones.
* Professional judgment and discretion when handling committee materials, leadership discussions and business information.
* Experience in a B2B or professional services environment

jobs.title: Senior Product Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**About Assembly Software**

Assembly Software is the team behind Neos, the case management platform purpose-built for personal injury law firms, with embedded intelligence that already knows your cases. We're trusted by 1,100 firms and 15,000 users nationwide, backed by more than 40 years of experience in PI case management. As a growing SaaS company with a passionate team, we're building software that makes cases easier to manage and outcomes better for the firms and clients who rely on it.

When you join Assembly Software, you’re joining a team that genuinely cares about you, your career, and your excitement about your job. When you work for a tech company in the legal field, there are endless opportunities ripe for disruption, and you’ll be on the forefront of that innovation. We want you to pursue what drives you and push your boundaries! Assembly Software is where people come to shake up a historically buttoned-up industry.

**Vision Statement**

Assembly's vision is to provide the legal community the best practice management software that enables client advocacy from anywhere at anytime.

**Mission Statement**

Our mission is to provide intuitive and comprehensive legal practice management solutions enhancing efficiency and profitability for our customers.

**Core Values**

* We are Accountable: We accept responsibility for our choices and actions. We value transparency + feedback.
* We Never Stop Learning: We pursue growth + learning.
* We Thrive as a Team: We value others' opinions + work respectfully with one another.
* We are Collaborative Innovators: We are adventurous, creative + open-minded.
* We are Here to Be of Service to our Customer + our Colleagues: No matter our role, we are all here to be of service + add value.
* We have Unyielding Integrity: We do the right thin, even when no one is watching.
* We Embrace Diversity + Inclusion: We are passionate about creating and cultivating an inclusive culture that promotes and values diversity.

Ask five people on a product team why a launch slipped and you'll get five different partial answers: Engineering thought Product had locked scope, Product assumed Sales already knew what was changing, and Sales is finding out today, from a customer, that something they promised isn't shipping the way they described it. That gap between good people doing good work is where this job lives, and we need someone who can't stand leaving it open.

As the **Senior Product Operations Manager** at Assembly Software, you'd be the product manager for how our Product organization runs. Not a coordinator keeping a status doc updated, and not a process owner for its own sake, but someone who treats how our PMs, designers, and engineers plan, prioritize, launch, and learn as a product in itself, with real customers, real friction points, and real room to get better. You'll build the scorecards leadership can read without asking anyone for an update, run the readiness process that makes sure Sales and Customer Success know what's shipping before it ships, and use AI daily in how you actually work, not as a line in a strategy deck.

We're not hiring this role to keep the trains running on time; we already have that. We want someone who looks at how Product, Engineering, and Design work together and can't help but see exactly what's slowing them down, then goes and fixes it, whether or not it was technically their job. You'll move comfortably between a spreadsheet and a hard conversation with a VP about why a process needs to change, and you'll know when to retire your own mechanism because it's stopped earning its place.

We're fully remote, no surprise return-to-office memo hiding in the offer letter, with medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k), and paid parental leave. You'd be joining a small, sharp Product team that takes real pride in what it ships and is ready to hand you real ownership from day one.

If this sounds like the seat you've been waiting for, we'd love to hear from you.

**When you’re considering a new job, it’s normal to have questions. Here are a few things we get asked all of the time:**

**1. I'm tired of the daily commute. Where are you located?**  
Assembly Software is a fully remote company. We work across time zones and connect through Teams, so you can build your career from wherever you do your best work: home office, favorite coffee shop, or yes, in your PJs if that's your vibe.

**2. What makes Assembly Software different?**  
Our people. We're a fast growing SaaS company and the leading provider of case management solutions for personal injury and legal firms. Through our three brands, Neos, Needles, and TrialWorks, we serve over 2,500 law firms and 40,000+ users, the largest user base in the industry. Backed by Ridge Road Partners since 2017, we combine decades of legal tech expertise with a scrappy, entrepreneurial energy. We move fast, we care about the product, and we have fun doing it. Our sales team also enjoys uncapped commission with built in accelerators, so top performers are rewarded for their impact.

**3. What's the benefits package like?**  
Competitive and comprehensive. You'll have access to:

* Medical, dental, and vision plans
* Short and long term disability coverage
* Supplemental insurance options
* 401(k)
* Flexible time off
* Paid parental leave
* An Employee Assistance Program

We invest in our people because we know our results depend on them. When you do great work here, you'll be recognized and rewarded for it.

jobs.description:
About the opportunity

Lead technical delivery and continued development of an established residential green building certification program serving single-family and multifamily housing. The program is primarily California-focused, with national reach.

This ongoing role suits an experienced architect, designer, construction professional, or building science or energy consultant seeking meaningful part-time work, including alongside an existing practice. Program-specific onboarding is provided.

Responsibilities

· Manage project intake, certification reviews, technical inquiries, documentation, and closeout; apply standards consistently and coordinate specialist input.

· Support raters through onboarding, renewals, continuing education, training, and practical technical guidance.

· Improve standards, checklists, verification processes, training, and workflows using research and stakeholder feedback.

· Manage CRM records, forms, reporting, and connected workflows. Use AI models to improve efficiency while verifying outputs.

· Monitor codes and industry developments; maintain relationships and represent the program in technical meetings, webinars, and partner discussions.

· Develop or review technical communications explaining program requirements and the value of certification.

Required qualifications

· At least five years of relevant residential design, construction, building science, energy consulting, green building, certification, or related experience, with independent project or program responsibility.

· Deep residential building science and broad green building knowledge across energy, water, indoor environmental quality, materials, carbon, site, transportation, and resilience.

· Strong understanding of green building certification criteria, supporting evidence, independent verification, and quality assurance. Experience applying certification standards or comparable technical compliance requirements.

· Ability to interpret codes and standards, distinguish baseline compliance from above-code performance, and improve technical guidance or processes.

· Strong CRM or comparable data and workflow software skills beyond Office, plus practical ability to use AI models, learn new systems, and troubleshoot routine issues.

· Sound technical judgment, clear communication, and reliable capacity to manage priorities and respond to participants.

Preferred experience

California building and energy codes, including CALGreen; direct residential certification experience; Salesforce and FormAssembly; relevant technical degree or equivalent professional experience.

Hours and flexibility

Guaranteed minimum 10 hours weekly, typically 20, with capacity up to 30 by agreement. Highly flexible scheduling with some Pacific business-hour availability and agreed response times and deadlines. California residency is not required.

How to apply

Submit your resume, relevant experience summary, hourly rate, earliest start date, and availability. Organization and program details will be shared with shortlisted candidates.

Pay: $40.00 - $70.00 per hour

Expected hours: 10.0 – 30.0 per week
