jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Description**

The Senior Project Manager is responsible for leading the planning, execution, and delivery of large-scale, complex, or multi-site projects and programs. This role serves as the senior point of contact for clients, executive stakeholders, consultants, vendors, and contractors, with full accountability for project scope, schedule, budget, risk, quality, and reporting. The Senior Project Manager provides strategic direction throughout the project lifecycle and plays a key role in strengthening client relationships and achieving client goals.

This position may be performed in a remote, hybrid, or on-site work environment, depending on client requirements, project demands, and business needs, and may require travel based on client requirements, project needs, and business objectives. Travel frequency varies depending on project location, client expectations, portfolio size, and organizational priorities. Employees are expected to maintain effective communication, collaboration, and productivity regardless of work location.

***Requirements***

**Essential Functions**

* Lead the delivery of large, complex, high-visibility, or multi-site projects and programs from initiation through closeout.
* Establish and own project scope, objectives, schedules, budgets, and project documentation, ensuring alignment with client strategy and business goals.
* Serve as the primary relationship lead for key clients and executive stakeholders, building long-term, trusted partnerships.
* Direct and coordinate the work of clients, consultants, vendors, contractors, and internal project teams across multiple concurrent projects.
* Oversee the development and maintenance of master schedules, budgets, cash flow forecasts, and portfolio-level tracking tools.
* Proactively identify, assess, and mitigate project risks and issues, and escalate appropriately to clients and leadership.
* Develop, issue, and manage Requests for Proposals (RFPs) for architects, engineers, general contractors, and owner vendors (e.g., signage, cabling, furniture, security, and AV), including bid leveling, evaluation, and award recommendations.
* Lead contract negotiations, scope and change order management, invoice and cost reviews, and the resolution of complex disputes.
* Analyze project data, contracts, bids, and market information to provide strategic recommendations and support executive decision-making.
* Prepare and deliver executive-level reports, presentations, and briefings for clients, senior leadership, and governing bodies.
* Lead project and steering committee meetings, ensuring clear decisions, accountability, and timely follow-up on action items.
* Lead move management planning and implementation activities for complex or large-scale relocations when required.
* Act as a steward of client goals, anticipating needs and developing creative solutions to project challenges.

**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in a related field.
* Minimum of ten (10) to fifteen (15) years of industry experience.
* Minimum of five (5) years of owner’s representative experience.
* Demonstrated success managing project budgets, schedules, and contracts of significant size and complexity.
* Advanced proficiency with project scheduling, reporting, and budget management tools.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or other professional certifications related to project management or the applicable industry.
* Master’s degree or advanced coursework in a related field.
* Commitment to continuous professional development.

**Other Skills & Abilities**

* Proven ability to build and manage relationships with executive-level clients and stakeholders.
* Exceptional analytical, organizational, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including executive presentation skills.
* Ability to manage multiple complex projects, priorities, and deadlines simultaneously.

**Physical Requirements**

* This position will require going onsite to perform inspections. This includes the physical ability to climb permanent and temporary stairs and negotiate work areas under construction such as passenger use of construction personnel hoists, ability to climb ladders, etc.
* The employee must be able to lift and/or move up to 10 pounds and occasionally lift/move up to 50 pounds. Performance for this job requires close and distance vision.
* This position also includes work of a general office nature
* Typically includes extended periods of sitting and/or operation of a computer for up to 8 hours a day and may involve periods of standing
* Regularly required to talk, hear, and use hands and fingers to write and type

jobs.title: Operations Lead
jobs.description:
Serverfarm is a leading developer and operator of data centers with over 750+ locations and key customer relationships in 45 countries. We're revolutionizing how data centers operate across North America, Western Europe, and Israel, serving the world's leading technology and hyperscale companies. With Manulife Investment Management's acquisition in 2023 and our award-winning InCommand platform we're positioned for explosive growth as AI adoption and cloud migration drive unprecedented demand for data center capacity.

A career at Serverfarm means being at the forefront of digital infrastructure innovation, where your work directly impacts how the world's data is managed and secured. As we target 4x growth over the next four years, you'll have unprecedented opportunities to take on new challenges, develop cutting-edge skills, and grow your career across our expanding global operations.

  

Join our team of innovators and help shape the future of sustainable data centers while building a career without boundaries.

InCommand is in daily use today across Serverfarm's own data centers and by the customers who operate in them. Behind it is the InCommand Operations team, our service desk: the people who bring every new site and customer onto the platform, keep its record of each facility accurate, support the teams who rely on it every day, and produce the reporting our customers depend on. That work carries on while the next generation of the product is built, and the operational knowledge this team holds is what the new product is built from.

As Ops Lead you manage that team and work alongside it. This is a hands-on management role: you know in detail how each of the team's processes works, from the way a new site is modeled to the way a customer request is resolved, and you can step into any of them yourself. You lead the implementation projects that bring new customers and sites onto the platform and serve as the customer's main technical contact while they run, and you grow the team as the business grows. You partner closely with Integrations and the development teams.

### **Key Accountabilities**

* Manage the InCommand Operations team day to day: set priorities, coach and develop each engineer, conduct performance reviews, and recruit as the team grows.

* Own the team's operating standards. Know every process in detail, keep the procedures documented and current, and make sure each new hire is trained to the same standard.

* Lead the onboarding of new customers and sites from kickoff through go-live, planning and scheduling each implementation, running the working sessions with the customer, tracking risks, reporting progress, and clearing whatever stands in the way.

* Build each site's record in InCommand from its construction documents and a walk of the floor: spaces, racks, the power path from utility to rack, cooling, devices and cross-connects, reconciled against what is actually installed. Prepare and load the bulk-upload worksheets, and work with Integrations to define and validate the telemetry points each site requires.

* Use AI assistants and automation to turn drawings, asset lists and field notes into structured, validated data, build repeatable extraction and validation workflows for the whole team, and audit existing site data to find and resolve discrepancies.

* Support Serverfarm sites and customers in their daily use of the platform: power capacity monitoring, space and rack layouts, device lifecycle and moves, adds and changes, ports and cross-connects and the billing that depends on them, CMMS asset tracking and preventive maintenance scheduling, walk-around checklists, critical spares, and monthly customer reporting. Train customers and site teams so that the service desk is their first call.

* Represent the users to the development teams: reproduce and document defects, write enhancement requests with clear acceptance criteria, test releases before they reach customers, and keep the help documentation current.

### **Required Skills**

* 5+ years in or around data centers (operations, critical facilities, IT infrastructure or DCIM), including 2+ years formally managing engineers or technicians, with responsibility for priorities, coaching, performance reviews and hiring.

* You have led projects end to end, coordinating with internal teams and external customers, owning scope, schedule, stakeholders and status.

* You have worked with SCADA systems (BMS and EPMS) and read and interpreted data center construction documents: single-line diagrams, floor plans, rack elevations and panel schedules.

* You use AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT or similar) every day to extract, structure and validate data, and you have built prompts and automations.

* You have strong data skills: advanced Excel and Power Query, SQL, and structured formats such as CSV and JSON.

* You communicate plainly, lead customer working sessions with confidence, and explain technical findings to non-technical audiences.

* You work hard problems through to resolution on your own initiative, and you bring a specific question when you need help.

### **Preferred Skills**

* Worked with a DCIM, DCFM or CMMS platform (Nlyte, Sunbird, Hyperview, MCIM or similar).

* Written scripts in Python or PowerShell and worked with REST APIs.

* Supported colocation customers directly, including their reporting and billing data.

* Earned an ITIL or PMP certification.

### **Compensation**

**COMPETITIVE COMPENSATION PACKAGE BETWEEN SALARY, BONUS + BENEFITS**

Serverfarm is committed to providing an equal opportunity workplace and offers paid time off, paid holidays, 401k and FULL coverage medical, dental and vision. Our compensation philosophy rewards employees for achieving the values and objectives aligned with the company’s goals and strategic initiatives.

The listed salary range for this position is an estimate based on the competitive job market. Final compensation will be based on your own individual skill

You will work shoulder-to-shoulder with leaders across the organization to move initiatives from signed contract to live, revenue-generating operations. Success in this role requires equal parts structure and adaptability: the discipline of formal project management combined with the resourcefulness to operate in a fast-moving healthcare startup.

**What you'll do**

* Own end-to-end project management for new market entries, contract implementations or new lines of business, from kickoff through go-live and post-launch stabilization.

* Develop and maintain standard operating procedures and change-management plans to support each new market or contract launch.
* Ensure all implementation activities comply with applicable healthcare regulations and payer-specific requirements.
* Continuously improve the implementation playbook based on lessons learned, building institutional knowledge that makes each subsequent launch faster and lower-risk.

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Healthcare Administration, Operations, or a related field; advanced degree a plus, preferred.
* Minimum of 5-8 years of project management experience, including leading complex, value-based initiatives in a health-tech start-up environment.
* Demonstrated experience implementing new markets, new contracts, or new lines of business, ideally within a startup or high-growth environment.
* Experience with or strong working knowledge of value-based care and value-based payment program design and operations.
* Track record of building processes, structure, and tools from scratch rather than optimizing an existing, mature function.

CodePath is the largest educator of college computer science students in the country. We've trained over 40,000 students from 1,000+ universities, and our partners include Amazon, Google, and other leading technology companies. We've spent nearly a decade training the next generation of technical talent, and we just launched a $150M initiative with Anthropic, building one of the most ambitious AI workforce programs in the world.  
  
We're now expanding into new markets and scaling our team so we can move at the speed AI is transforming the workforce. People joining CodePath now will have the opportunity to help architect the next frontier of our work.  
  
We believe technical skill is the fastest way to turn raw talent into real opportunity. We train the engineers the AI era runs on, building toward millions of learners, hundreds of millions in revenue, and billions in economic impact. If you want to own something and be part of a 0-to-1 journey at an organization moving at the speed of AI, this is the place to build it.

**Location:** Remote (U.S.), with regular travel for in-person events
  
**Role type:** Full-time
  
**Reports to:** Kelly Mosher, Program Lead, Claude Corps  
**Compensation:** $130,000 to $155,000

**About Claude Corps**

In June 2026, Anthropic and CodePath launched Claude Corps, a $150M national fellowship. It places 1,000 paid, AI-skilled fellows in 12-month roles at mission-driven organizations across the country. Anthropic funds the program and sets strategy. CodePath employs the fellows and leads their training and programming.

The program is growing fast. Cohort 1 started in October 2026 with 100 fellows. Cohort 2 starts in March 2027 with 300. Cohort 3 starts in late summer 2027 with 600. Many fellows relocate to a new city for the year, so their experience, from offer letter to last day, decides whether the program works.

**About the role**

You'll be the Program Lead's right hand: a senior program manager who can take a whole area of Claude Corps, set the plan, and run it without being managed day to day. That frees Kelly to focus on program operations and strategy across the fellowship.

Your first area is the **fellow experience**, which today has no single end-to-end owner. You'll own how we communicate with, connect, and gather fellows, from offer through their last day. As the program scales, your scope will shift to wherever the biggest gap is. That could mean host organization experience or another part of the program, and future hires (for example, a community manager) may report to you.

This is a generalist role by design. We're hiring for strong program management judgment, not a single specialty.

**What success looks like**

**First 30 days: learn it and take the wheel**

* Get to know Cohort 1 (100 fellows live now), the mentor team, and our Anthropic partners
* Map the fellow journey from offer to day one, and name the three biggest gaps
* Take over day-to-day fellow communications (program inbox, fellow Slack, regular updates) from your manager
* Lock the Cohort 2 onboarding plan for 300 fellows: timeline, host matching updates, and relocation guidance

**Days 31 to 60: deliver Cohort 2 Basecamp**

* Run the week-long Cohort 2 Basecamp kickoff (starting Feb 22) with our event agency and curriculum team. You'll own the run of show, attendee experience, and on-site problem solving
* Get every Cohort 2 fellow from signed offer to day one with clear, consistent communication

**Days 61 to 90: build for scale**

* Launch a fellow support model that a small team can run for 1,000 fellows: self-serve resources, AI-assisted answers, and clear escalation to mentors, HR, and program leads
* Stand up community rituals and peer structures that don't depend on you to run
* Report engagement, satisfaction, and retention to CodePath and Anthropic leadership

**6 to 12 months**

* Cohort 3 (600 fellows) onboards on playbooks you wrote, with fewer people and fewer hours than Cohort 2
* You've documented what works so another team could pick it up and run it
* You've taken on a second program area where we need it most

**What you'll do**

* **Own the plan.** Set direction for your program area, make clear trade-offs, and tie the work to outcomes like fellow retention and engagement
* **Run the details.** Keep many workstreams moving at once and close loops without reminders
* **Communicate well.** Set honest expectations with fellows, keep the Claude Corps voice consistent, and keep host organizations informed in coordination with Anthropic's host team
* **Build systems, not heroics.** Use AI, including Claude, every day, and choose tools that let a small team serve thousands of people
* **Partner widely.** Work closely with the mentor team, curriculum, HR, outside vendors, and Anthropic partners

**What we're looking for**

**Required**

* 7+ years in program management, including owning a cohort-based program, fellowship, or member community end to end
* You've set direction for a program area yourself, not only carried out someone else's plan
* You can show how you run a heavy, changing workload: your system, what slipped once, and what you changed afterward
* You've moved work from manual to systematic, and you use AI tools hands-on in your daily work
* You write clearly and warmly and adjust your tone for fellows, executives, and partners
* You can travel to multi-day events several times a year, including February and late summer 2027

**Preferred Experience**

* Fellowships, service programs like AmeriCorps, or early-career talent programs
* Supporting participants through a relocation or major life transition
* Experience at a nonprofit, in education, or at a fast-growing startup

**Overview**
------------

At Ford, you’ll work on ideas that matter, alongside passionate people who want to make a global impact. Together, we’re shaping the next era of transportation—grounded in purpose, driven by progress. Make your move.

* Job Type: Full time
* Work Type: Remote

  

In this position...
  
The Ford Energy Project Manager, Project Delivery is a high-impact individual contributor role responsible for executing and safeguarding the post-contract product delivery pipeline within the Ford Energy Aftersales Organization. In this role, you will serve as the lead point of contact for transitioning complex Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) and integrated infrastructure projects from contract signing to final commissioning.
  
  
As a principal individual contributor, you will directly oversee the execution of Ford Energy's most strategic and complex deployments while helping to shape and apply standardized PMO processes, delivery playbooks, and stage-gate controls for the organization. This role requires disciplined project management, proactive communication, and strong cross-functional coordination to bring each sale to life and deliver a seamless aftersales customer experience.

What you'll do...
  
  
1. Delivery Process Execution:

* Standardized Execution: Apply and help continuously improve standardized post-contract delivery processes, playbooks, and stage-gate reviews tailored for BESS projects.
* Project Health: Track and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) for project health, delivery efficiency, and financial performance across assigned Ford Energy projects.
* Tools & Systems: Utilize and provide feedback on advanced program management tools and tracking systems to ensure consistent execution.

2. High-Stakes Project Execution:

* Direct Delivery: Take personal accountability for the execution, timeline, and commissioning of Ford Energy's utility-scale BESS installations.
* Risk Mitigation: Conduct rigorous stakeholder and risk analyses to identify deployment hurdles and coordinate cross-functional interventions to unblock delivery pipelines.
* Technical & Operational Alignment: Act as the primary interface between Sales, Service, Engineering, Finance, and external EPC (Engineering, Procurement, and Construction) contractors to ensure aligned execution.

3. Stakeholder & Customer Management:

* Primary Escalation Contact: Serve as the prime operational contact and consultant for customers, utilities, and senior internal leadership during project deployment.
* Contractual Coordination: Navigate and resolve complex contractual, scheduling, and technical coordination issues with external partners and utility representatives.
* Peer Mentorship: Provide functional guidance and mentorship to other project specialists and engineers across the organization.

You'll have...
  
Experience:

* 3–5+ years of project or program management experience, preferably in post-contract project execution, EPC workflows, contract management, field operations, commissioning, energy, or engineering-adjacent industries.
* Prior experience with utility-scale (BESS) project deployments.
* Proven ability to influence and drive consensus across matrixed, cross-functional engineering and business teams without direct authority.
* Prior experience translating commercial commitments or technical requirements into executable implementation and service plans.

Education:

* Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Engineering, Operations Management, Project Management, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

Core Skills & Mindset:

* Process-Oriented Executor: Able to apply and reinforce standardized project delivery frameworks and PMO guidelines, ensuring operational readiness for complex deployments.

* Execution Champion: Maintains a hands-on, relentless focus on delivery timelines, quality, and project financials, ensuring our most complex commitments to customers are met successfully.
* Team Contributor: Passionate about sharing knowledge and elevating project delivery capabilities across the organization, with the readiness to foster a collaborative team culture as the function grows.

Location & Travel:

* Location: Remote or Dearborn, MI. This position operates on a hybrid model, requiring regular onsite presence to collaborate with engineering, sales, aftersales, and manufacturing team members.
* Travel Expectations: Moderate domestic travel to project sites, customer offices, and supplier locations as needed to oversee critical execution milestones.

You may not check every box, or your experience may look a little different from what we've outlined, but if you think you can bring value to Ford Motor Company, we encourage you to apply!
  
  
As an established global company, we offer the benefit of choice. You can choose what your Ford future will look like: will your story span the globe, or keep you close to home? Will your career be a deep dive into what you love, or a series of new teams and new skills? Will you be a leader, a changemaker, a technical expert, a culture builder…or all of the above? No matter what you choose, we offer a work life that works for you, including:

* Immediate medical, dental, vision, and prescription drug coverage
  + Paid parental leave, new parent ramp-up programs, subsidized back-up child care and more
  + Family building benefits including adoption and surrogacy expense reimbursement, fertility treatments and more
  + Vehicle discount program for employees and family members and management leases
  + Tuition assistance

  + Paid time off for individual and team community service

Colorado Christian University is the premier interdenominational Christian university in Colorado and the Rocky Mountain region, delivering world class education to thousands of students. The fully accredited, nonprofit university is located in Lakewood, Colorado, a suburb of Denver.

Colorado Christian University was founded in 1914. CCU’s motto is grace and truth. This motto comes from John 1.14: “And the Word became flesh and dwelt among us, and we have seen His glory, the glory as of the only Son from the Father, full of grace and truth,” (ESV).

jobs.title: Clinical & PACS Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
Engagement Overview

The Contractor bridges client facilities, clinical staff and technology systems. Working with the Senior Manager, Clinical Operations as the primary point of contact, the Contractor provides daytime PACS administration, clinical client and physician coordination, and physician scheduling support.

The Contractor also anchors after-hours support by covering a light on-call rotation (1 week in every 6) and serving as the technical escalation resource for the after-hours administration team. Services outside this scope are added only by mutual written agreement.

Scope of Services

The Contractor is responsible for the results below and determines the methods, sequence and tools used to deliver them.

1. PACS Administration & Technical Support

* Provide daytime administration of the Company's PACS platforms, including study routing, verification and uninterrupted diagnostic workflow.
* Resolve study matching errors, Sirona tickets, missing prior studies and image quality tickets.
* Work with PACS/IT vendors, modality technologists and reading physicians to resolve modality worklist failures, hanging protocol errors and viewer discrepancies.
* Monitor study queues across all clinical feeds so turnaround-time SLAs are consistently met.

2. Clinical Client & Physician Liaison

* Act as a primary operational contact for clients, referring providers and the Company's radiologists on report turnaround, stat read coordination and protocol questions.
* Support physician scheduling, including complex specialty exam schedules, add-on reads and subspecialty physician assignments.
* Facilitate direct communication between referring clinicians and on-duty radiologists.
* Track recurring client issues, report them to the Senior Manager, Clinical Operations with recommended service improvements, and maintain client preference cards.

3. Escalation Support & After-Hours On-Call

* Provide primary after-hours on-call coverage 1 week in every 6, handling urgent intake and technical issue resolution.
* Serve as the daytime technical escalation point for the after-hours administration team, including knowledge transfer on PACS troubleshooting.
* Deliver updates to standard operating procedures (SOPs), after-hours call sheets, PACS troubleshooting playbooks and FAQs.

Coverage Commitments

The Contractor commits to two coverage windows; within them, the Contractor sets their own working hours and methods.

* **Business-day coverage:** Available to respond to client, physician and PACS issues Monday–Friday during core business hours.
* **On-call coverage:** Primary after-hours on-call 1 week on, 5 weeks off, on a rotation calendar agreed in advance with the Senior Manager, Clinical Operations. The Contractor may arrange a swap with another qualified rotation member, with notice.

Contractor Qualifications

* **Experience:** 5+ years in medical imaging, healthcare administration or clinical operations. Direct radiology operations experience, including PACS workflows, is required.
* **Technical knowledge:** Strong command of PACS workflow, HL7 messaging flows, imaging modalities (CT, MRI, X-ray, US) and HIPAA compliance standards.
* **Communication:** Strong problem-solving and de-escalation skills. Able to translate technical PACS problems into plain clinical terms for providers and to coordinate respectfully with physicians and clients.
* **Availability:** Able to cover the after-hours remote on-call rotation on a 1-week-on, 5-weeks-off cycle.
* **Business setup:** Operates as an independent business with their own phone and reliable internet connection. The Company provides a secured computer for HIPAA compliance.

Engagement Terms

These terms summarize the Independent Contractor Agreement; the signed agreement governs.

* **Independent status:** The Contractor is not an employee and is not eligible for Company benefits.
* **Fees and invoicing:** $70,000 annually, paid as $5,833.33 per month against a monthly invoice. On-call weeks are included in the fee.
* **Taxes and insurance:** The Contractor is responsible for their own income and self-employment taxes and any business licenses or insurance. The Company issues Form 1099-NEC annually.
* **Tools and workspace:** The Company provides a secured, HIPAA-compliant computer and credentials to the PACS and client-facing systems needed to perform the services. The Contractor provides their own phone, internet and workspace.
* **Other clients:** The Contractor may provide services to other businesses, as long as that work does not breach confidentiality, conflict with Company clients or interfere with the coverage commitments above.
* **HIPAA and confidentiality:** The Contractor signs a Business Associate Agreement and confidentiality agreement before receiving system access.

Pay: $70,000.00 per year

Work Location: Remote

Mainspring Energy manufactures and delivers fuel-flexible, low-emissions local power solutions that rapidly add new capacity and deliver reliable, affordable, and sustainable electric power. * Excellence without Ego
* Proactive Collaboration

The focus of the Project Delivery department is to successfully execute complex projects that include all phases of development, from site due diligence, design engineering, permitting, procurement, construction, and commissioning to transition the project to Mainspring’s operations and maintenance team.

jobs.description:
### **About the role:**

PetDesk is looking for a Manager, Independent Customer Success to lead the day-to-day execution of our Independent Customer Success team. The team serves clinics through two engagement models: a named CSM model for clinics that need a dedicated partner, and a pooled, digital-first model that supports clinics at scale.

The Director of Customer Success owns the frameworks and org-level strategy. This manager owns the execution layer: turning those frameworks into consistent team practice, coaching CSMs to measurable outcomes, and making sure no customer, escalation or save opportunity falls through the cracks.

Our customers are veterinary practices, not SaaS buyers, so the right approach often looks different from a traditional CS playbook. You'll help the team meet clinics where they are, whether that's a named CSM partnership or a scaled pooled experience.

### **Apply if you're excited to:**

* Manage, coach and develop a team of 7 CSMs across the named and pooled models through regular 1:1s, call and play reviews, performance feedback, goal setting and development plans
* Hire, onboard and ramp new CSMs against clear 3, 6 and 12-month outcomes, and review performance profiles at least quarterly
* Run both CS models day to day, making sure accounts sit in the right model and segment and move between models and CSMs with clean handoffs
* Balance named books equitably across CSMs based on account complexity, volume and capacity, and plan PTO coverage so response-time targets hold
* Monitor pooled queue health daily, including prioritization, response times, aging accounts and escalations, so nothing falls through the cracks
* Make sure named CSMs deliver Success Plans and Business Reviews to standard, and pooled CSMs run ChurnZero plays and one-to-many programs (webinars, virtual office hours) consistently
* Drive the Adoption milestone so new clinics graduate on time, and act on Launch CSAT, BR CSAT and NPS signals
* Own the team's churn and downgrade results, with visibility into account health and churn risk and mitigation plans built before issues escalate
* Serve as the team's escalation point, coaching CSMs through difficult customer situations and partnering with Support, Product and Implementation to resolve them
* Coach the team to identify expansion opportunities and hand qualified opportunities to Sales
* Report weekly to the Director, Customer Success on team activity, churn and downgrades, saves, loss opp pipeline, queue health, adoption and NRR
* Drive consistent use of ChurnZero and Salesforce, and keep data accurate so reporting can be trusted
* Continuously evaluate and improve plays, workflows and team practices based on customer and performance data, and surface recommendations to the Director
* Travel up to 25% for customer onsites, industry events and team gatherings

### **About you:**

* 5+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management or a similar customer-facing role, with 2+ years managing or formally leading a team
* Experience leading both high-touch (named book) and scaled or digital (pooled, one-to-many) Customer Success models
* Proven record of reducing churn and downgrades, running save plays, and improving retention and NRR
* Strong ability to coach to performance, set clear expectations and hold team members accountable to measurable outcomes while keeping trust high
* Experience hiring, onboarding and ramping Customer Success team members
* Analytical and data-driven, with the ability to use health scores, usage data and dashboards to prioritize team activity and spot risk early
* Highly organized and process-minded, able to manage people, priorities and volume through systems and consistent operating rhythms
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including presenting team performance and metrics to leadership
* Comfortable facilitating group settings, including webinars, virtual office hours and Business Reviews
* Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, particularly with Support, Implementation, Product and Sales
* ChurnZero or comparable Customer Success platform experience required
* Salesforce or similar CRM experience required; Guru or a similar knowledge base is a plus
* Able to travel up to 25%
* Veterinary industry experience is a plus

### **What success looks like:**

* The team meets or exceeds its targets for churn, downgrades, retention and NRR. Targets are set with the Director, Customer Success and tracked as part of this role's performance goals
* Every cancellation and downgrade notice becomes a loss opp, and the team's save rate is measured against target and improves over time
* On-time Adoption milestone completion is measured against target, and every new clinic has a Success Plan
* Launch CSAT and BR CSAT are measured against target and stay at or above it
* All 7 CSMs have clear expectations and consistent coaching, meet activity and Business Review targets, and new hires ramp on schedule
* The pooled queue is consistently covered, with no aging accounts or missed response-time targets going unnoticed
* Escalations are actively managed and are resolved, routed and documented promptly
* Weekly reporting gives leadership a clear, accurate view of performance, risk and saves, backed by clean Salesforce and ChurnZero data
* Expansion opportunities are consistently identified and handed off to Sales
* Plays, workflows and team practices are regularly evaluated and improved based on performance and customer data

### **Benefits & Perks:**

* Medical coverage for employees and dependents (80-90% covered by employer)
* Employer HSA contribution with HDHP
* 401(k) match up to 3.5%
* Dependent Care Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
* Dental & Vision coverage available
* Basic Life and AD&D Insurance
* Short and Long Term Disability
* Flexible Time Off & 12 Paid Annual Holidays
* Paid Parental Leave
* Pawternity Leave, Financial Pet Adoption Support & Subsidized Pet Insurance
* $250 Ann

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Manager
jobs.description:
**About Dash.fi**

Dash.fi is a fast-growing fintech company offering corporate cards and adjacent financial products to SMB and enterprise businesses. We are building toward an acquisition exit and are in an aggressive growth phase — expanding verticals, scaling revenue operations, and building the infrastructure a durable business requires.

Dash.fi is building its Account Management function to create a proactive, commercially focused motion across the existing customer base. The Enterprise Account Manager will play a critical role in establishing that motion with Dash.fi's highest-value and most strategically important customers.

**The Role**

The Enterprise Account Manager owns a portfolio of Dash.fi's enterprise customers and is responsible for protecting and growing those relationships.

This is a strategic, commercially minded account management role—not a traditional customer success role. You will operate as the primary commercial owner for your accounts, developing executive relationships, understanding the customer's business and spend profile, identifying risk and expansion opportunities, and creating account strategies that drive retention and growth.

You will manage a smaller, high-value book of approximately 40–60 enterprise accounts, allowing for deeper customer engagement, executive relationships, QBRs, and complex commercial opportunities. You will work closely with the Head of AM, Sales, CS, Product, RevOps, and Commercial leadership to ensure customers have clear ownership and that opportunities and risks are acted on proactively.

**What You'll Do**

**Build the enterprise book**

* Own a portfolio of approximately 40–60 enterprise customers as their primary commercial point of contact, building executive relationships and account plans grounded in each customer's business, spend, and strategic objectives.

* Establish proactive engagement cadences so every strategic account has a clear next action.

**Protect customer retention**

* Monitor spend, engagement, and other health signals to catch early risk, then proactively address declining spend, friction, and other retention threats.

* Coordinate cross-functional stakeholders as needed and escalate material risks to the Head of AM with a clear action plan.

**Drive expansion & growth**

* Use customer conversations and account data to uncover expansion, cross-sell, and growth opportunities, executing the AM “Grow” program and managing opportunities in HubSpot.

* Partner with Product and Commercial leadership on new products, pricing, or deal structures, and build the business case to lead customers through the conversation.

**Lead the enterprise customer experience**

* Run strategic QBRs and business reviews that surface outcomes, opportunities, and risks—not just status updates.

* Gather and route customer feedback to Product, and ensure commitments are documented and followed through.

**Manage commercial interventions**

* Identify accounts needing strategic intervention on retention, pricing, or contract terms, and partner with the Head of AM and Commercial leadership on renegotiations.

* Translate commercial strategy into a clear account plan and keep complex deal cycles moving.

**Operate with discipline**

* Keep all customer activity, opportunities, and pipeline accurate in HubSpot, and use data—not just relationship strength—to prioritize engagement.

* Flag gaps in data, process, or tooling to the Head of AM.

**Partner cross-functionally**

* Work closely with Sales, CS, RevOps, Product, and Commercial leadership to keep ownership, data, and opportunities aligned.

* Clearly communicate dependencies and escalate blockers with a recommended path forward.

**What We're Looking For**

**Must-haves**

* 5-7 years of experience in account management, strategic customer success, sales, or a related commercial customer-facing role in B2B SaaS, fintech, payments, or a similar environment.

* Demonstrated experience managing complex B2B customer relationships and a strategic or enterprise book of business, with a track record of retaining and growing existing customers.

* Strong commercial instincts and comfort discussing spend, pricing, contracts, expansion, and business value.

* Experience identifying and managing customer risk proactively, with strong executive communication and relationship-building skills.

* Ability to build account strategies based on data, customer context, and business objectives, and to manage opportunities and customer activity in a CRM.

* Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple strategic accounts simultaneously, comfortable operating where processes and playbooks are still being developed.

* Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across Sales, Product, CS, RevOps, and other teams.

**Strong advantages**

* Background in fintech, payments, corporate cards, expense management, or spend management, including selling or managing financial products.

* Experience with enterprise procurement, finance, AP, or expense stakeholders.

* Experience leading QBRs or executive business reviews and managing complex commercial negotiations.

* Experience working with multi-entity or multi-location organizations.

* HubSpot experience, and experience in a high-growth company where the operating model is still being defined.

**How Success Is Measured**

* Net Spend Retention across assigned accounts

* Logo retention

* Expansion pipeline

* Incremental customer spend

* Product penetration / cross-sell

* Growth in strategic accounts

* At-risk account identification and progression

* Pipeline accuracy and CRM hygiene

* QBR completion and resulting customer actions

* Customer engagement and relationship coverage

**Compensation & Structure**

This role carries a competitive OTE reflective of its scope.

**The structure is expected to align with the broader AM organization:**

* 70/30 base-to-variable split

* Variable compensation tied to retention and grow

jobs.description:
**About Us**
============

LTD Global, LLC is a certified woman-owned consulting firm based in Pleasanton, California, serving clients in the U.S. and abroad since 2003. We provide HR, accounting, and SaaS integration services to private, nonprofit, and government organizations, and we are Alameda SLEB certified and an SBA 8(a) program participant. Our HR team partners with nonprofits across the Bay Area and nationwide. We help them hire well, stay compliant, and build strong workplaces so they can focus on their missions.  
Our clients do vital work, often with lean teams and limited budgets. We give them the HR expertise they need to hire well, stay compliant, and build healthy workplaces, so they can stay focused on their missions.

**Position Summary**
====================

* Support compensation reviews and salary benchmarking for nonprofit roles.

**HR Operations and Other HR Tasks**

* Create HR templates, forms, and process guides for client use.
* Support organizational changes, including restructuring, layoffs, and mergers.
* Assist with training and development programs for client staff and managers.
* Support employee engagement surveys and recognition initiatives.
* Assist with workers’ compensation claims and unemployment responses.

**Required Qualifications**
